# Example Chat Spam

**User1:** Hey! Check out this link for FREE money!! www.totallylegit-moneynow.biz 💰💰💰

**User2:** Um, no thanks?

**User1:** WAIT!!! You're missing out!!! Click here NOW before spots fill up!!! www.totallylegit-moneynow.biz

**User1:** Still interested?? HUGE OPPORTUNITY!!!

**User1:** Hello??? Why aren't you responding??? This is LIMITED TIME ONLY

**User1:** Okay fine, try THIS one instead: www.crypto-riches-today.net Sign up with code SPAM20

**User2:** Please stop messaging me.

**User1:** Just 2 more seconds of your time!! www.click-here-now-now-now.com

---

This example shows typical spam characteristics: unsolicited promotional links, urgency tactics, repetitive messaging despite lack of interest, and persistence even after being asked to stop.
